purpose: Prevent revised current-history values from being mistaken for new point-in-time forward observations.

APPEND_NEW_ELIGIBLE_FOR_ATOMIC_PIT_REVIE.reason: Candidate introduces a strictly newer observation period and may proceed to the existing single-series PIT contract.

REVISION_SAME_PERIOD_WITHHELD_PENDING_RE.reason: Same observation period but changed value; forward use is forbidden until release-specific revision timing/provenance is independently certified.
